bug_tax.mechanism: Billed at ~$1.00 per task credit across Celery worker retries. Platform debits the user for agent-authored syntax errors, broken imports, and circular retry loops.
bug_tax.economic_conflict: Adversarial monetization where the platform generates higher gross revenue the more buggy and incompetent its agents are. 18 retry loops cost users upwards of $23.00 for a dead deployment.
bug_tax.stage_gate_counter: Zero-Charge Failure Guarantee enforced by an ACID Two-Phase Commit (2PC) credit escrow ledger. Net credit burn on failure is invariant: Delta B == 0.00. Self-healing loops (max 3) are absorbed as platform COGS.

perpetual_take_rate.mechanism: 20% to 50% perpetual tax on customer top-line gross revenue (GMV) plus a 20% surcharge on all managed Meta/Google ad spend.
perpetual_take_rate.economic_conflict: Destroys early-stage venture unit economics. Mathematical proof shows net LTV:CAC collapses from 4.33x down to 1.01x, consuming 98.6% of early-stage gross margin.
perpetual_take_rate.stage_gate_counter: Strict 0% perpetual revenue take-rate and 0% ad spend markup. Direct OAuth integration with founder's personal Stripe Connect and Meta/Google ad accounts.

proprietary_lockin.mechanism: Code hosted in closed multi-tenant Docker containers. No Git sync, no database exports, no migration history. Subscription cancellation instantly revokes Traefik routes and deletes customer database volumes.
proprietary_lockin.economic_conflict: Founders are held technical hostages. Canceling or disputing predatory charges destroys the entire business and user data.
proprietary_lockin.stage_gate_counter: 100% Continuous Dual-Push Full Git Ejection. Every line of code, Prisma migration, and Dockerfile syncs to the founder's personal GitHub/GitLab org. AST scan guarantees zero proprietary runtime dependencies.

false_done_hallucinations.mechanism: Relies on shallow process exit code 0 and curl HTTP 200 checks. Marks ventures as completed while serving blank Next.js template landing pages with fatal hydration crashes, unwired Stripe webhook secrets, invalid TLS SANs, and corrupted schemas.
false_done_hallucinations.economic_conflict: Founders spend money driving paid traffic to non-functional, crashing applications, generating customer chargebacks and brand destruction.
false_done_hallucinations.stage_gate_counter: 5-Stage Deterministic Verification Engine: Next.js strict compilation (<250KB first load), raw socket TLS 1.3 handshake, Quad-DoH DNS quorum (3 of 4 resolvers), Playwright synthetic checkout with Stripe Test Clock, and AST clean-room scan.

positioning_operationalization.public_facing_stance: Focus ad copy and top-of-funnel hooks on founder symptoms (wasted nights, broken checkouts, credit drain) rather than attacking obscure competitor brands directly.
positioning_operationalization.internal_intelligence_use: Deploy forensic Polsia teardowns, technical breakdowns, and head-to-head matrices strictly in bottom-of-funnel comparison pages and objection handling.
